content.short: Crypto Bot is a Telegram crypto wallet for storing, exchanging, paying, invoicing, and sending coins.
content.description: Crypto Bot is a cryptocurrency wallet and payment bot inside Telegram. Public listings describe a multi-currency wallet, P2P market, exchange, virtual checks, invoices, subscriptions, and Crypto Pay integrations for Telegram bots and services. It is relevant to TON because it gives Telegram users a direct way to hold, send, receive, and pay with TON and other assets. Crypto Bot belongs with wallets because the main job is custody, account access, transfers, signing, dapp connection, or asset management.
